title: 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: The presenter says “Choose this option” while pointing silently. What is missing?
elements.explanation: The listener needs the option identified.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Which alternatives does 1.2.3 permit?
choices: Audio description or an alternative for time-based media
elements.correctAnswer: Audio description or an alternative for time-based media
elements.explanation: Either approach can satisfy this Level A criterion subject to the exception.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Does a text alternative alone satisfy 1.2.5?
elements.explanation: The Level AA requirement separately calls for audio description.
